VBO:0201271.summary: Spaniels range from sporting breeds developed to find, flush and retrieve game to toy companions. Welsh Springers illustrate the flushing branch, while Cavaliers and English Toy Spaniels belong to companion branches.
VBO:0201271.shortDescription: Spaniels span working bird dogs and toy companions, with distinct breeds and different traditional roles.
